name: Trí Nguyên Aquarium
kicker: The rock aquarium on Hòn Miễu
summary: Rock aquarium on Hòn Miễu: boat over and walk the aquarium for an island stop in the bay. The scenic fee for the Trí Nguyên route is 6,000 VND a person, plus 3,000 VND at the pier. The boat fare sits outside that fee. The tanks sit with the other island stops in the bay.
dotReason: A short island stop for the aquarium building, useful with a bay boat and lighter than the reef day.
getThere: By boat to Hòn Miễu. The scenic fee is 6,000 VND.
heroCaption: The rock aquarium above the boats at Trí Nguyên

notice.title: 6,000 VND is the crossing, not the tanks
notice.body: The bay scenic fee for Đảo Hòn Miễu (Trí Nguyên) is 6,000 VND a person, plus 3,000 VND at the pier. The boat, and any aquarium ticket at the door, are separate.

body: Trí Nguyên is the aquarium on Hòn Miễu, one of the island stops beside the jet-ski beaches and the Hòn Mun reef. The building is the artificial rock above the landing, with the boats tied along the path.

The route Đảo Hòn Miễu (Trí Nguyên) is 6,000 VND a person each crossing from the inland pier, plus 3,000 VND to use the pier. That charge follows the crossing. It does not set the aquarium door. Ask for the tank ticket when you land.

figures.caption: The landing path and a tour boat below the hill
figures.alt: A blue tour boat at the stone pier on the aquarium island in Nha Trang Bay

gettingThere: The aquarium is on Hòn Miễu. Boats leave Bến tàu Du lịch Nha Trang and Bến thủy nội địa Phú Quý. Pay the scenic fee online or at the pier, then the boat.

legs.heading: From the inland pier
legs.body: Choose the Hòn Miễu (Trí Nguyên) route, 6,000 VND, and add the 3,000 VND pier charge. The boat fare is extra.

legs.heading: From Cầu Đá
legs.body: Cầu Đá is the south port for the reef boats. Hòn Miễu uses Bến tàu Du lịch Nha Trang and Bến thủy nội địa Phú Quý.

admissionNote: The crossing fee is 6,000 VND a person, plus 3,000 VND for the pier. The boat fare and any tank ticket are separate. Children under 6 and Khánh Hòa residents are among those exempt. A child from 6 to under 16 pays half. The fee excludes accident insurance.
